service.description: Fetch the branch of a remote kind repository from its remoteUrl into its bare mirror, created by the first fetch. The local branch is replaced by the remote one. Records lastFetchDate, lastFetchError and headCommitId on the repository. Refused in sim mode.

Fetch every remote kind repository whose fetchIntervalMinutes has passed since its lastFetchDate (for the fetch_AllGitRepositories_frequent ServiceJob). A repository that fails has its error recorded and logged, and the others are still fetched.
Make a repository ready: create the bare repository of a local kind (a local repository is also created on its first use), fetch a remote kind for the first time. A db kind needs nothing.

parameter.name: contentRepository
parameter.description: A repository of content, such as a web site's images: keep images, video, audio, PDFs and archives in Git LFS (setup#GitLfs)

service.description: Keep the files matching patterns in Git LFS: a commit of the repository's .gitattributes with filter=lfs for each pattern it does not have. A git:// write of such a file stores its content as a content blob and commits its LFS pointer; git-lfs clients push and fetch it at /git/repositoryId.git/info/lfs.

parameter.name: patterns
parameter.description: gitattributes patterns (*.png, media/**); images, video, audio, PDFs and archives when empty

parameter.name: commitId
parameter.description: Empty when it had them all

service.description: Write a db kind repository as a bare repository on disk, with its branch and HEAD, so it can be cloned and pushed with the git command line. Object ids are the same as in the database.

parameter.name: targetPath
parameter.description: Relative to the runtime directory unless absolute; the repository's localPath (default runtime/git/repositoryId) when empty

service.description: Copy a branch, with all of its history, into a db kind repository, replacing its branch.

parameter.name: source
parameter.description: git://otherRepositoryId, a repository directory (bare or not), or a URL to fetch (HTTPS; file and ssh run the system git and ssh); the repository's remoteUrl when empty

service.description: The branches and tags of a repository, each with the commit it names and, for an annotated tag, the tag object.

parameter.name: refType
parameter.description: branch or tag; all refs when empty

parameter.name: refList
parameter.description: Maps: refName, shortName, refType (branch, tag, other), objectId, isDefault, annotated, commitId, summary, commitDate, authorName, tag (tagName, targetId, targetType, message, taggerName, taggerEmail, taggerDate)

service.description: Commits reachable from a revision, newest commit date first.

parameter.name: revision
parameter.description: A branch or tag name, a full ref name, or a commit id or prefix; the default branch when empty

parameter.name: path
parameter.description: Only the commits that changed this path against their first parent

parameter.name: afterCommitId
parameter.description: Start after this commit: the last commitId of the previous page

parameter.name: limit
parameter.description: At most 500

parameter.name: commitList
parameter.description: Maps: commitId, shortId, treeId, parentIds, authorName, authorEmail, authorDate, committerName, committerEmail, committerDate, summary, body, message, trailers (a Map of name to a List of values), moquiUserId

service.description: A commit and the files it changed against its first parent (every file for a root commit). No commit out when the revision names no commit.

parameter.name: commitId
parameter.description: A commit id or a unique prefix of at least 4 hex digits, or a branch or tag name

parameter.name: stats
parameter.description: Count inserted and deleted lines of each file

parameter.name: commit
parameter.description: As each map of get#GitLog commitList

parameter.name: fileList
parameter.description: Maps: path, changeType (added, modified, deleted), oldObjectId, newObjectId, and with stats binary, tooLarge, insertions, deletions

service.description: The line diff of each file a commit changed, or of one file. A binary file, or a side over 1 MB, has no diff.

parameter.name: fileDiffList
parameter.description: Maps as get#GitCommit fileList, with unifiedDiff and html (an escaped moqui-diff table, for a render-mode text type="html,qvt") for a text file

service.description: The file at a path in a revision; no out parameters when it is not a file there.

parameter.name: text
parameter.description: A UTF-8 file without NUL bytes

parameter.name: bytes
parameter.description: Any other file

service.description: The URLs to clone a repository with: HTTPS from the git_public_url property (else the webapp host and port properties) and, when the SSH server is on, SSH with the current user's username, from ssh_public_host and ssh_public_port (else the webapp host and ssh_port).

Commit files on the default branch of a local or db repository in one commit, with a message, as the current user (with the Moqui-User-Id trailer). Needs AT_GIT_REPOSITORY update on the repository. A gitECA rule with source write sees it.

parameter.name: fileMap
parameter.description: Path to its new text (or bytes)

parameter.name: commitId
parameter.description: Empty when nothing changed

service.description: Delete the objects of db kind repositories that no ref reaches (and no change in progress or of the last git-server gc-reflog-days days needs) and that were not written or referenced in the last git-server gc-prune-days days; then repack: store the versions of each path as deltas of each other, the newest whole, compress rows written before the zlib format, and make delta chains deeper than git-server db-delta-depth shorter (for the gc_GitRepositories_daily ServiceJob). A repository whose refs reach a missing object is not collected. A repository that fails has its error recorded (lastGcResult) and logged, and the others still run.

parameter.name: repositoryId
parameter.description: Every db repository when empty

parameter.name: dryRun
parameter.description: Count what would be deleted and change nothing

parameter.name: timeoutMinutes
parameter.description: When repacking stops; the deletes are done first

parameter.name: results
parameter.description: A Map per repository: repositoryId, deletedCount, deletedBytes, repackedCount, savedBytes, objectCount, storedBytes, summary, or error

service.description: Decode every object of a db kind repository (applying its deltas) and check it against its id, and that every ref points to an object that is there. An error names the damaged objects.
Run the gitECA post events (ref-update, commit, tag, post-receive) of a pending GitUpdate, as the user who made it. Nothing when it is not pending (it ran, or another worker has it).

Run the post events of every pending GitUpdate, after putting back the ones a restart cut short (for the process_PendingGitUpdates_frequent ServiceJob). One that fails is recorded on its row and logged, and the others still run.

Delete GitUpdate rows in ecaStatus done or none whose updateDate is older than daysToKeep (for the clean_GitUpdates_daily ServiceJob). A row's GitUpdateRef rows go first. A row that cannot be removed is logged and the others still go.
What the current user may do in a repository: view (clone, read), create (new branches and tags), update (fast-forwards, merges, commit statuses) and delete (force, delete refs, settings, archive).
The repositories the current user may view, by id, paged. Archived ones are left out unless includeArchived (or archivedOnly).

parameter.name: repositoryIdList
parameter.description: Only these (a project's repositories)

parameter.name: text
parameter.description: In the id or description

parameter.name: repositoryList
parameter.description: Maps: repositoryId, description, repositoryKind, branch, headCommitId, lastUpdateDate, archivedDate, defaultMergeMethodEnumId, remoteUrl, openMergeRequestCount

service.description: The push log of a repository, newest first: every push (accepted or not), mirror fetch, import and write through Moqui, each with its refs and the state of its gitECA rules. For its viewers.

parameter.name: source
parameter.description: push, fetch, import or write

parameter.name: updateList
parameter.description: Maps: updateId, source, transport, userId, username, remoteAddress, updateDate, ecaStatus, ecaError, processedDate, refList (refName, shortName, changeType, oldObjectId, newObjectId, result)

service.description: The directory at a path in a revision: directories first, then files, each with its last commit on the revision's first-parent line (from the path index of the branch, or of the commit). Nothing out when the revision or the path names nothing; isFile when the path is a file (read it with get#GitBlob).

parameter.name: revision
parameter.description: A branch, tag or commit; the default branch when empty

parameter.name: path
parameter.description: The directory; the root when empty

parameter.name: branch
parameter.description: The branch the revision names, when it names one

parameter.name: entryList
parameter.description: Maps: name, path, type (dir, file, executable, link, submodule), objectId, size (a file kept in LFS: its content's), lfs, lfsOid, lastCommit (commitId, shortId, summary, authorName, authorEmail, authorDate, committerDate, moquiUserId)

service.description: A branch, or a tag (annotated, by the current user, when a message is given), at a revision. Needs create; the branch rules apply as to a push, and the change runs the gitECA rules of source write (so Mantle's link rules follow) and is in the push log.

parameter.name: refName
parameter.description: A branch or tag name, or a full refs/heads/ or refs/tags/ name

parameter.name: refType
parameter.description: branch (the default) or tag

parameter.name: revision
parameter.description: What it points to; the default branch's head when empty

parameter.name: message
parameter.description: For a tag: makes it annotated

parameter.name: objectId
parameter.description: The commit, or the annotated tag object

service.description: Delete a branch or tag. Needs delete; the default branch cannot be deleted, a protected one only when its branch rule allows. Runs the gitECA rules of source write.

parameter.name: refType
parameter.description: branch or tag, for a short name that is both

service.description: What head has that base lacks, as GitHub's compare: the merge base, the commits in head and not in base (oldest first, at most 250), ahead and behind, the files changed from the merge base to head with their line counts, and with withDiffs each file's diff (at most 300 files) as the moqui-diff html and as hunks of numbered lines for review. With checkMergeable a trial merge of head into base.

parameter.name: base
parameter.description: The target; the default branch when empty

parameter.name: head
parameter.description: The source

parameter.name: commitList
parameter.description: Maps as get#GitLog's

parameter.name: fileList
parameter.description: Maps: path, changeType, oldObjectId, newObjectId, binary, tooLarge, insertions, deletions, diffed, and with withDiffs html and hunks (oldStart, oldLines, newStart, newLines, lines: tag, oldNo, newNo, text)

service.description: Merge a source revision into a target branch as the current user, by method: GmmMerge (a merge commit), GmmFastForward (refused when the target has commits the source lacks), GmmSquash (one commit of the merged tree on the target) or GmmRebase (each commit of the source replayed on the target). Refused on a conflict (the paths in conflictPaths), when the target already has the source, and by the target's branch rules (a protected target changes through merge#MergeRequest). Needs update; the change runs the gitECA rules of source write. With checkOnly a trial merge that changes nothing (view is enough).

parameter.name: source
parameter.description: A branch, tag or commit

parameter.name: target
parameter.description: A branch

parameter.name: message
parameter.description: Of a merge commit or squash; a default when empty

parameter.name: commitId
parameter.description: The target's new head

service.description: Archive a repository: read only from now (pushes, ref writes, merges and writes refused), its open merge requests closed, left out of find#GitRepositories unless asked. Needs delete.
Make an archived repository writable again. Needs delete.
A repository's description, default branch (an existing branch) and default merge method (GmmMerge or GmmSquash). Needs delete.
The branch rules of a repository that name a ref (every rule without one), and what they ask together. For its viewers.

parameter.name: allowedMergeMethods
parameter.description: Empty: any

service.description: Create or update a branch rule. Needs delete on the repository.
Delete a branch rule. Needs delete on its repository.
A check of a commit by outside CI, in GitHub's status shape. Needs a push right on the repository (a CI user with an access token); the commit must be in the repository.

parameter.name: state
parameter.description: pending, success, failure or error

parameter.name: context
parameter.description: default when empty

parameter.name: target_url
parameter.description: GitHub's name for targetUrl

service.description: The statuses of a commit, or of many: the latest of each context and the combined state (failure when any failed or erred, pending when any is pending, success when all succeeded). For its viewers.

parameter.name: commitId
parameter.description: A commit, or a branch or tag

parameter.name: commitIdList
parameter.description: Full commit ids, for a log page

service.description: The webhooks of a repository, the secret left out. Needs delete on the repository.

Create or update a webhook: an http or https URL, the events (push, tag, merge_request; all when empty), the secret its deliveries are signed with (kept when left empty on an update), active. Needs delete on the repository.
Delete a webhook; its deliveries not yet sent are cancelled. Needs delete on its repository.
Send a ping event to a webhook now, recorded as a delivery. Needs delete on its repository.
The deliveries of a webhook, newest first, each with its attempts' errors: the delivery log. Needs delete on its repository.

parameter.name: deliveryList

service.description: The send service of SystemMessage type GitWebhook: POST the message's JSON to its webhook's URL with X-Moqui-Event, X-Moqui-Delivery and, with a secret, X-Hub-Signature-256 (sha256= the HMAC-SHA256 of the body). Internal addresses are refused unless git-server webhook-private-network. A status that is not 2xx is an error, so the delivery is retried.
For the framework's post-receive gitECA rule (Git.gitecas.xml): a push event per branch that changed and a tag event per tag, to each active webhook of the repository that takes it.

parameter.name: refUpdates
parameter.description: As org.moqui.GitServices.process#GitEca's

service.description: Any other event of a repository (merge_request, with an action) to each active webhook that takes it: payload as the body, with event, action, repository and sender.

Send again the webhook deliveries that failed, each after a wait that doubles with its failures (1, 2, 4 ... minutes); after retryLimit failures it is in error and no longer tried (for the retry_GitWebhookDeliveries_frequent ServiceJob). One that fails is logged and the others are still tried.
